name: VoicePromptKit
description: A Turkish-first toolkit for Vapi voice-agent prompts. Audit across six lenses (/prompt-check), converse with the prompt's persona in a live call simulator (/prompt-chat) — with variable binding, silence handling, and call closure — and replay saved scenarios as regression tests (/prompt-test). Scenarios and variables live in <prompt>.anchors.yaml / <prompt>.vars.yaml sidecars; the prompt file is never modified. Cost-tuned via target_model / worker_model / judge_model split.
